title: Your gym closed, now what? (crisis time lifting advice)
summary: Quick advice as gyms close for the coronavirus: accept this isn't a time for gains, maintain with bodyweight work, don't chase YouTubers' clickbait home programs, and don't build a home gym now while prices spike.

claims.claim: During a gym closure you won't make gains and that's fine; aim to mitigate muscle loss, not build mass.
Maintain muscularity with push-ups, pull-ups if you have a bar, ab work, bridges for the lower back, and air squats; work on form and mindset.
No need to follow the crisis programs fitness YouTubers are pushing; just do what you can.
Don't build a home gym during the crisis: prices are spiking because everyone is buying equipment for the new clickbait programs; wait until it's over.

exercises.name: Push-ups / pull-ups / air squats / bed bridges
